reference_sample_server.note: Flower Shop reference merchant (samples/rest/python/server) — the KNOWN-COMPLIANT target for self-validation. RE-PINNED 2026-08-13 from 52377503 (2026-08-10). Ten commits, verified == upstream main HEAD at re-pin time. Python golden behavior: OUR #169 (order-event webhooks now SIGNED per RFC 9421 with Content-Digest over raw bytes + bounded retry with backoff — this is what turned the webhooks.signed/.retries tripwire red and let the flower config flip them ON, the designed payoff), #176 (shipped/shipping events now schema-valid). Node reference behavior: OUR #174 (checkout errors answered with the UCP error envelope, 18 sites — the CHK-050/053 flat-`detail` differential allowlist entries self-expired RED at this pin and were DELETED per the register contract), #175 (webhook deliveries retried on transient failure — makes webhooks.retries flippable for the Node target; HELD until Node also signs via our approved samples#179, so one future re-pin flips the Node config for both), #171 (idempotency hashes op-scoped, mirroring Python #166 — our probes already mint fresh keys per op), #170 (Node 24 support), #177 (log invalid validation payloads), #178 (line items included in shipped events). #172/#173 are A2A-side only, no REST wire effect. A no-op test still passes against this server, which is why every check also needs a negative fixture (mutation proxy). Run on port 8182; sim endpoints gated by --simulation_secret.
reference_sample_server.sdk_resolution: This SHA DROPPED the server pyproject's [tool.uv.sources] ucp-sdk = { path = '../../../../python-sdk/', editable = true }. The server therefore resolves ucp-sdk from PyPI, NOT from our SHA-pinned vendored python-sdk. Left unmanaged that turns a pinned golden into a floating one, defeating the purpose of this lock, so the resolved PyPI version is recorded in reference_sdk.pypi_pin and asserted at boot.

reference_sdk.pypi_pin_note: BUMPED 2026-08-03 from 0.4.3: PyPI 0.4.4 (uploaded 09:16Z, release v2026-04-08-4) is the release cut for our merged python-sdk#57 (contains/minContains/maxContains validators enforced on generated models). The golden survives these stricter validators because samples#152 (valid seeded totals) was built for exactly that combination — the #57/#152 coordination proved 69/0 with validators active. serve_golden.sh asserts this exact version at boot.
reference_sdk.note: HOW THE GOLDEN GETS ITS SDK CHANGED AT THE 2026-07-31 RE-PIN. Before: the 2026-01-23 Flower Shop server took ucp-sdk as an editable path dep, so this vendored SHA (f54858e, the last 2026-01-23-compatible SDK, 0.3.0 — the commit immediately before python-sdk main's 'upgrade SDK to UCP v2026-04-08', which ImportErrors on Checkout from ap2_mandate) WAS the SDK under test. After: the re-pinned server has no [tool.uv.sources], so it installs ucp-sdk from PyPI and this vendored clone is no longer what the golden runs. The clone is still materialized (cheap, and it keeps the 01-23 trio reproducible), but the version that actually matters for a reproducible verdict is pypi_pin above — the resolved PyPI release the golden runs on. serve_golden.sh asserts the installed version equals pypi_pin and fails loudly on drift, so a silent PyPI bump can never change a verdict unnoticed. Bump pypi_pin deliberately, the same way a SHA is re-pinned. The underlying rule is unchanged: pin compatible trios (conformance/samples/SDK), not bare main.

ap2_reference.note: The pinned AP2 reference implementation — the interop ORACLE for the moving AP2 mandate delegate-chain layer (testbed/provenance.py REFERENCE_SHA, testbed/gen_goldens.py). It is a FIXTURE, never a graded subject; the testbed pip-installs it at this exact SHA (`pip install git+https://github.com/google-agentic-commerce/AP2@e1ea56d`). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the AP2 pin: testbed/provenance.py.REFERENCE_SHA must equal this commit, and the P1-9 self-expiring known_ap2_reference_defects register keys its re-pin trigger to it (a filed AP2 defect entry EXPIRES the moment a re-pin makes the reference produce the correct outcome). Before this lock entry the AP2 pin lived ONLY in provenance.py prose, so an AP2 upstream release was detected by NOBODY — this closes that blind spot: pinned to ref `main`, the sources-age tripwire (sources_age.py --check) now compares this commit to AP2 upstream HEAD and warns on drift, which is exactly the re-pin trigger the P1-9 guard needs to become real. Verified 2026-04-29 e1ea56d == AP2 main HEAD at 2026-08-11 (upstream quiet since v0.2, 2026-04-29). Re-pin deliberately, the same discipline as every other pin; when re-pinned, re-verify provenance.REFERENCE_SHA and let the self-expiring defect entries reconcile.
